target.title: fix(media): normalize case-insensitive file:// URI schemes in MEDIA directives (#103473)
target.body:
# What Problem This Solves

close #103473
URI schemes are case-insensitive per RFC 3986 §3.1, but `normalizeMediaSource()` used a case-sensitive `startsWith("file://")` check, causing uppercase variants like `FILE://` or `File://` in `MEDIA:` directives to be passed through without stripping the scheme prefix.

## Evidence

### Vitest — 59 passed (including 2 new regression cases for uppercase FILE:// / mixed-case File://)

```
$ pnpm test src/media/parse.test.ts
 RUN  v4.1.9

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  59 passed (59)
```

### Inline normalizeMediaSource() verification

```
=== normalizeMediaSource fix evidence ===
Fix: use toLowerCase().startsWith("file://") + src.slice(7)

Input:  "file:///tmp/generated.png"   -> Output: "/tmp/generated.png"
Input:  "FILE:///tmp/generated.png"  -> Output: "/tmp/generated.png"
Input:  "File:///tmp/generated.png"  -> Output: "/tmp/generated.png"
Input:  "FILE:///Users/pete/My File.png" -> Output: "/Users/pete/My File.png"
Input:  "/plain/path.png"           -> Output: "/plain/path.png"  (unchanged)
```

### splitMediaFromOutput 管线端到端验证（模拟 assistant → 提取 → clean text）

```
Assistant 输出:  "Here is your image.\nMEDIA:FILE:///tmp/generated.png"
提取后的文本:   "Here is your image."
Media URL:      ["/tmp/generated.png"]
原始指令泄漏?   ✅ 否

Assistant 输出:  "Check this screenshot.\nMEDIA:File:///tmp/screenshot.png"
提取后的文本:   "Check this screenshot."
Media URL:      ["/tmp/screenshot.png"]
原始指令泄漏?   ✅ 否

Assistant 输出:  "See attached.\nMEDIA:file:///tmp/photo.jpg"
提取后的文本:   "See attached."
Media URL:      ["/tmp/photo.jpg"]
原始指令泄漏?   ✅ 否

Assistant 输出:  "Result:\nMEDIA:/tmp/result.pdf"
提取后的文本:   "Result:"
Media URL:      ["/tmp/result.pdf"]
原始指令泄漏?   ✅ 否
```

### 修复前后对比（Bug 复现）

| 场景 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|------|--------|--------|
| MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/g.png | 原始指令泄漏到回复中 | 正确提取为附件 |
| MEDIA:File:///tmp/g.png | 原始指令泄漏到回复中 | 正确提取为附件 |
| MEDIA:file:///tmp/g.png | 正确提取（已有工作） | 正确提取（不变） |

## Code Change

`src/media/parse.ts` — scheme comparison 改为 case-insensitive；用 `slice(7)` 替代 `.replace()` 因已确保前缀匹配：

```diff
- return src.startsWith("file://") ? src.replace("file://", "") : src;
+ return src.toLowerCase().startsWith("file://") ? src.slice(7) : src;
```

`src/media/parse.test.ts` — 2 个新回归测试用例：

```diff
+ ["/tmp/generated.png", "MEDIA:FILE:///tmp/generated.png"],
+ ["/tmp/generated.png", "MEDIA:File:///tmp/generated.png"],
```

## User Impact

Affected: 任何 assistant/tool 输出中使用非小写 `file://` scheme 的文件 URI（确定性触发）。
Severity: low，但用户可见——期望的本地附件被静默丢弃，原始指令文本泄漏到回复正文中。

Fixes #103473
